verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents dispositioning alerts and an automatic audit trail covering all work in the platform, which together cover resolving an alert with an audit record. Nothing documents explicitly marking a false positive, or reopening or overriding a resolved decision. The 90-day pending review is a scheduled periodic review, not an on-demand reopen. Missing for 10: explicit false-positive resolution workflow, documented reopen/override of a closed decision, audit record specifically tied to override actions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can resolve a false positive and reopen or override the decision with an audit record

citations.quote: Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
Automatic audit trail: This feature ensures that you have comprehensive audits of all work that occurs in Hummingbird.
